_about: Thresholds of check-card.mjs. Every number of a check is copied from the «Проверка» section of the Scapes bible (styles/scapes/<doc>, check <check>) and lives only here; check-card.mjs reads it by id. norm = the bible's «норма» (outside it: WARN, look by eye); limit = the bible's «предел»/«граница»/hard rule (outside it: FAIL). proposed = the bible marks the threshold «порог предложен»: a breach is a WARN, never a FAIL (CHECKLIST.md). avoid = reference cards the bible names as «избегать» for this rule; exceptions = reference cards the bible names as allowed exceptions to the rule (a FAIL on either is expected). target / target_about = the aim of the post-generation adjustment step that the bible states next to the check; not a check, read by adjust-trial.mjs. Values under `method` are NOT from the bible: they are parameters of the measurement (how a pixel rule is turned into a number); each says where it comes from.

BASE_RULES.1.title: file 430 x 480, no transparent pixels, no frame

COLOUR.1.title: median C* of the card
COLOUR.1.note: below 30 only when white or wood fills most of the frame, or night/evening — confirm by eye
COLOUR.1.target_source: COLOUR.md «5. Насыщенность и яркость после генерации»: the aim of the adjustment step (the reference median), not a check

COLOUR.2.title: share of grey pixels (C* < 8)
COLOUR.2.note: above 11 %: check by eye that the grey is a material (white, metal, asphalt, stone, wool)

COLOUR.3a.title: share of near-black pixels (all channels < 24)
COLOUR.3a.note: and only on black things — by eye

COLOUR.3b.title: C* of the darkest 2 % of the card
COLOUR.3b.note: may be lower only when black or grey things are in the frame — by eye. Measured as C* of the mean colour of the darkest 2 %, as the bible's analysis did

COLOUR.6.title: number of 30° hue bins holding >= 5 % of the frame (C* >= 15)
COLOUR.6.note: 2 or 6–7 admissible but rare; 1 only with a one-colour backdrop and a dark, almost colourless hero — by eye

COLOUR.7.title: hero separated from the abstract backdrop
COLOUR.7.note: if the measure took the backdrop seen through the hero or dark inserts as the hero's main colour, check by eye (#77, #115)
COLOUR.7.exceptions_source: COLOUR.md check 7: the neon sign #38 (cyan cream on a green wall, hue diff 28°, dL 10) is set off by its glowing pink and yellow tubes, not by its main colour

COLOUR.8d.title: lightness spread inside the backdrop (L* p90 - p10)

COLOUR.9a.title: backdrop 3–30 px from the hero minus the four 60 x 60 corners, L*
COLOUR.9a.note: exceptions: a support under the hero (wood, sand: #95) and a dark backdrop behind a glowing hero — then a breach is a WARN to check by eye

COLOUR.9b.title: chroma drop to the corners (near C* - corner C*)

COLOUR.9c.title: hue shift to the corners, degrees

COLOUR.10.title: darkest 5 % of the backdrop keep the chroma of its middle (ratio)

COLOUR.11.title: coloured shadow: darkest 15 % of each hue family keep the chroma of its mid tones (lowest ratio)

COLOUR.12.title: share of hue shifts in the wrong direction (shadow towards yellow, light away from yellow)

COLOUR.14.title: day sky at the top: top 12 % band

COLOUR.15a.title: night/dusk: median L* below the day median

COLOUR.15b.title: night/dusk: median C* close to day (reference night/dusk range)

COLOUR.15c.title: golden hour or dusk: median L* evening-dark (at most the lightest reference evening card)
COLOUR.15c.exceptions_source: COLOUR.md check 15: the beach #100 is marked golden hour but its white sand, foam and pale sky make it as light as day (median L* 73.7); by eye it reads as a warm day, not as an evening to aim at

BACKGROUNDS.4a.title: pattern step between neighbouring bands, L* (median of measured band edges, as the bible's analysis reported it)

BACKGROUNDS.4b.title: pattern band edge width, px (median, 10–90 %)
BACKGROUNDS.4b.note: norm: 1–2 px on 44 of 53 measured graphic-pattern reference cards; 2.5–5 px on #12, #35, #44, #47, #50, #66, #73, #107, #137

BACKGROUNDS.6a.title: rays per full turn
BACKGROUNDS.6a.variant_note: about 29 thin rays is an admissible variant (#73)

BACKGROUNDS.6b.title: light ray / dark gap width, degrees (medians)

BACKGROUNDS.6c.title: ray centre on the hero's vertical, % of frame width

BACKGROUNDS.6d.title: ray centre height vs hero middle, % of frame height (+ = below)

BACKGROUNDS.7a.title: ring centre vs hero centre, % of frame (+ = right/below)

BACKGROUNDS.7b.title: rings from the centre to the far corner

BACKGROUNDS.8a.title: no horizontal stripes (stripe angle from horizontal, degrees)

BACKGROUNDS.8b.title: stripe direction: vertical, or rising to the right at about 40° or about 74°; on a wall only vertical

BACKGROUNDS.9.title: floor line height and hero base below it, % of frame height

COMPOSITION.2.title: hero box centre, horizontal offset from the frame middle, px
COMPOSITION.2.note: more only if the scene explains it (a sign or companion at the side) — by eye
COMPOSITION.2.exceptions_source: COMPOSITION.md «Постоянные» 1: the seven reference cards whose offset the scene explains

COMPOSITION.3.title: hero box centre below the frame middle (240 px), px (+ = lower); norm and limit by staging group
COMPOSITION.3.groups_rule: characters > 0 → characters; otherwise the backdrop (field, wall, none, environment)

COMPOSITION.4a.title: hero box area, share of the frame
COMPOSITION.4a.note: limit «около 30 %»: the smallest reference hero is 29.9 % (#44)

COMPOSITION.4b.title: hero box width on an abstract backdrop, share of the frame

COMPOSITION.5a.title: top margin to the main mass (thin tips excluded), px
COMPOSITION.5a.exceptions_source: COMPOSITION.md check 5: thin tips allowed above the margin (#45 straw, #132 umbrella, #38 top of the neon sign) and the cut thin tail of #32

COMPOSITION.5c.title: object on an abstract backdrop or at a wall is whole: share of a frame edge covered by the hero mask
COMPOSITION.5c.exceptions_source: COMPOSITION.md check 5: a thin long tail of a structure cut by the edge (#32) and a door built into the wall, cut by the bottom edge with it (#55)

COMPOSITION.11.title: safe zone: no main mass in the top 40 px and in the rounded 80 x 80 top corners
COMPOSITION.11.note: the bible checks the main mass only against the top 40 px and the rounded top corners (beyond the 80 px arc: FAIL; inside the 80 x 80 square: look by eye); the rect x 25–405, y 45–465 is for faces, eyes and text, by eye — at the sides and bottom the main mass follows checks 5 and 6
COMPOSITION.11.exceptions_source: COMPOSITION.md check 5 (the same cards as COMPOSITION.5a): thin tips allowed above the margin (#45 straw, #132 umbrella, #38 top of the neon sign) and the cut thin tail of #32

RENDERING.2.title: (guide only, never a failure) highlight centroid above, shade centroid below the hero centre

RENDERING.3.title: night/dusk: luma of the darkest 0.5 % > 25 and of the lightest 0.5 % > 200

RENDERING.4.title: no outline: dark-band share at the silhouette in the cleanest of 8 directions
RENDERING.4.avoid_source: RENDERING.md 1.1: drawn contour lines only on #23; #83 drawn as a flat icon; both are what to avoid (author's decision)

RENDERING.11.title: near-white (luma >= 235, low saturation) share of the hero
RENDERING.11.note: more only if the hero has big white parts (dial, paper, white body) — by eye

RENDERING.16a.title: grain in flat areas (mean |Laplacian| of luma); reference range from «Обработка после рисования»
RENDERING.16a.target_source: RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке: цель и начальные настройки»: the aim of the adjustment step, not a check

RENDERING.16b.title: no JPEG 8 x 8 grid (strongest of 8 phases / mean of the others; above 1.2 only on one axis of six reference cards)

RENDERING.17a.title: median overshoot at sharp luma steps
RENDERING.17a.target_source: RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке: цель и начальные настройки»: the aim of the adjustment step (a scene matching the soft grand set gets no sharpening), not a check

RENDERING.17b.title: median width of sharp luma steps over the whole card, px
RENDERING.17b.target_source: RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке: цель и начальные настройки»: the aim of the adjustment step, not a check

RENDERING.18.title: busyness: share of the card's pixels on a strong luma step, %; norm and limit by staging group
RENDERING.18.groups_rule: characters > 0 → scene; otherwise backdrop field or wall → abstract; otherwise (environment, none) → environment
RENDERING.18.proposed_note: a group marked proposed only warns past its limit: scenes, whose improved prompts do not pass yet (2026-10-30); abstract backdrop and environment are blocking
RENDERING.18.note: busier than the references: small detail on the ground, foliage or props (tiny flowers, photo-like pebbles) instead of a few large soft masses — check by eye
RENDERING.18.note_low: calmer than most references of the group — look by eye

visual.what: staging reads as the ordered category (1 floats with no support on a pattern or near-flat sky/water; 2 plain untextured floor or wall; 3 visible real material under the hero, abstract backdrop or one flat wall; 4 ground/horizon with 3+ planes, a surface filling the frame, an interior, or a structure cut by the bottom edge against plain sky; 5 one or two of the five characters in a category-4 setting)
no plate, stars or caption drawn in the picture
no fine surface texture on the hero (also RENDERING 12)
staging and category by the tables; for categories 2 and 3 whether the support's material texture is visible
a floating hero: patterned backdrop (not a plain gradient), no shadow patch below it, not in a setting with ground and horizon
pattern in one hue, no second pattern over it
glow centre behind the hero; without a dome the floor or the lower half is lighter (by eye only: the bible gives no number)
floor runs the full width to the bottom edge; far edge straight for a plain plane or boards, ragged for grass, wavy for sand and waves
no backdrop: no sky, wall or horizon; a dividing diagonal is welcome

setting: 3–4 planes (1–2 in open sky or water); far plane softer but no bokeh; horizon behind the hero at a height matching the camera; clouds and branches do not cross the middle of the hero's silhouette; sky lightens downwards
characters only in a setting
an object without characters is shown by day unless the object needs light (neon, headlights, sunset over a road)
lit white is warm cream or neutral; white in shadow is cool or neutral, never yellow-grey or brown-grey
night sky blue, ultramarine or blue-violet; window and lamp light warm yellow
one hero object or one scene; at most two companions
crop: in a setting or scene the bottom and sides may be cut; the top only for a structure or the background, never a head
camera not straight down (steeper than 60°); from below only for a tall or heroic hero; no backdrop: from above at an angle
tilt: a floating object 0–40° (15–30° preferred); a standing object upright unless leaning
volume: a boxy object shows two sides or the top; front-on only with relief, round body, deep opening or visible thickness and shadow; never a flat sticker (#23, #83)
number of separate things: 1–3 normal, 4–7 admissible, 8+ only if the hero is made of or filled with many parts

faces, eyes, text and anything that must read inside x 25–405, y 45–465 and outside the 80 x 80 top corner squares; only backdrop and thin tips in the top 40 px and the rounded top corners (when the main mass was not measured this is the whole check)

brand mark: only a house or a cow head, one per card, not on a character scene by default; on the front face, silhouette 25–80 px (8–25 % of the hero box width), made in the material and light of the thing
key light from the upper left: brightest faces top and top-left, shade bottom and right; cast shadow to the right or lower right; a rim light from any side is fine
a light rim usually along the top edges (with check 4)
no sharp edges or straight drafting edges; thin parts thicker than real; squat proportions
a visible support has a contact shadow; a floating hero has no shadow
soft shadows, penumbra well over a couple of pixels; no hard cast shadow

no fine texture (mesh, pile, terry, weave, frost, soot, pores, hairlines); wear rare and in bold simple shapes (a paint chip), no rust, dirt stains or scratch networks; small parts readable and rounded; hero smooth, no brush strokes; foliage as clumps of glossy leaves
effects soft, semi-transparent, simplified; a glow does not change the hero's lighting
no visible grain or noise at full size; no vignette

1–2 of the five characters, each recognisable by the main feature and colour landmarks, clothing rules, real setting, head fully in frame (top not above 25 px), scene box 60–90 % of the frame, view not profile, the character does something with an item of its set, one gentle joke that reads at a glance (twist object fully in frame, reaction in face and gaze), figure cut as ordered

frame_dE.source: script: an edge line counts as a band where it differs from the picture 6–8 px inside by more than this dE

frame_share.source: script: a side has a band when that share of its positions differs; four sides = frame (FAIL), one to three = plate or strip (WARN)

main_mass_open_px.source: script: the hero mask opened by this radius drops parts thinner than 11 px — the «thin tips» COMPOSITION 5 and 11 allow above the margins

safe_zone_tolerance_px.source: script: main-mass pixels allowed outside the safe zone

safe_zone_top_depth_px.source: measured (2026-10-30, outlines cut in the boxes by eye on the 81 abstract-backdrop references): the main mass of #25, #35, #36 and #45 starts at y 38–39 px — the 38 px top margin of COMPOSITION.md check 5 — so the 40 px band of check 11 is counted from this many px above its edge

backdrop_colour_strict_placements.source: measured (2026-10-30, outlines cut in the boxes by eye on the 81 abstract-backdrop references): COLOUR 8a, 9a, 9c and 10 hold for every hero alone on the backdrop (these placements); with a floor, a support or a wall the hero stands on or hangs on, the floor and the wall enter the backdrop measures and 22 references go past a limit (8a #32 #66 #85 #154; 9a #28 #38 #45 #46 #53 #55 #103 #142; 9c #20 #25 #34 #53 #64 #123 #135; 10 #6 #14 #26 #38 #85 #114 #123), so there a breach is a WARN to check by eye

stripe_angle_tolerance_deg.source: script: how far a measured stripe angle may be from 40°, 74° or 90°

rays_cut_from_below_skip_height.source: BACKGROUNDS 6: for a hero cut by the bottom edge the ray centre goes down with it — height not checked

exclusion_box_without_hero_pct.source: script: when the hero was not found, the backdrop measures skip this central box (x0, y0, x1, y1 in % of the frame); hero-relative checks are then not measured

floor_supports.source: BACKGROUNDS.md «Линия пола и камера»: the supports whose floor line the bible measured on abstract backdrops (plain floor, piece of real surface, floor at a wall or furniture)

tail_cover_max.source: script: a hero touching an edge over at most this share of the edge length is a thin cut-off tail (COMPOSITION 5 allows it; the poles of #3 and #12 cover about 5 %)

compare_at_bible_precision.source: script: a measured value is rounded to the decimals of the bible threshold before comparing (the bible gives 15 rays for a measured 15.1 on #11, 46 % for a measured 45.8 % on #32)

busyness_luma_step_min.source: RENDERING.md check 18 (2026-10-30): a pixel is on a strong luma step when hypot(gx, gy) of the luma central differences (gx = Y[x+1] − Y[x−1], gy = Y[y+1] − Y[y−1], luma as in measures.mjs) is above this; the value the comparison of factory cards with the references used, not tuned further

known_measure_failures.source: the bible's analysis: reference cards whose automatic ray / ring / stripe centre or period (and the step of #85) was checked by eye and found wrong when the bible was written; the bible gives eye estimates for them. COLOUR.7 #54 (checked by eye 2026-10-30): the outline cut in its box takes the cyan glow plate behind the lawnmower as the hero, so hero and backdrop measure as one colour
